classification.difficultyReason: Find the normal hourly rate from total earnings across normal, time-and-a-half and double-time hours.

content.prompt: Sally earned \$329.40 in a week. If she worked 10 hours during the week and 6 hours on Saturday at time and a half and 4 hours on Sunday at double time, what was her hourly rate of pay?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Equivalent normal hours} &= 10 + (6 \times 1.5) + (4 \times 2)\\\text{Equivalent normal hours} &= 27\\\text{Normal hourly rate} &= \frac{329.40}{27}\\\text{Normal hourly rate} &= \$12.20/\text{h}\end{align*}$$
